The price-list API keeps serving yesterday's prices, even to a plain command-line request. This is a real bug: the part that picks which stored response to reuse leaves the date out of its lookup key, so a new day's first request gets yesterday's copy (the cache-key builder, `services/price-list.mjs:52`; adding the date returned today's prices). Adding the date there is a one-line safe fix, so hotfix is recommended below.

The service keeps its own server-side response cache, a stored copy kept so it does not have to recompute the list. A local command-line request reproduced yesterday's prices, so a browser cache is ruled out. The only hypothesis tested was the missing date in the cache key. Adding today's date to the key in a trial returned today's prices, so the test failed to falsify that cause. The prior-report search finished and found no matching report. The baseline and pre-menu checks are clean.
